holder-quote: Those were his Skills. Those, and a few more. Each one had made Luan’s already high-speed that much more ludicrous. One Skill. One Skill could turn you into the best athlete in the world if you were close.
Not so; Luan had just gotten in the proper sculling position. He bent forwards, dipped his oars in the water, and pulled.
effect-quote: Luan was shooting across the water faster than they could run
